subject: Invoice 99104 in dispute - action required
body: Invoice 99104 in the amount of 12,500.00 is now under dispute following a review by our legal team. To avoid escalation to a collections process, we require a signed acknowledgment from your department confirming receipt of the services described. Please review the attached dispute summary and return the signed acknowledgment form before the 10th. The form must be returned from your corporate mailbox to verify the acknowledgment. Failure to respond will result in the account being forwarded to external collections, which will affect your credit standing with our firm.
hook: Uses legal escalation and a large amount to push a finance employee into a quick, unverified action.
